101	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   102	// Module-level concurrency guard for persona rebuild
   103	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   104	
   105	/** True while a `node scripts/build-personas.js` process is running. */
   106	let buildInProgress = false;
   107	
   108	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   109	// GET /api/models
   110	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   111	
   112	/**
   113	 * Returns the current model registry list.
   114	 *
   115	 * Auto-initializes `local.json` from `default.json` if it does not exist
   116	 * (delegates to `readModels()` which handles the initialization).
   117	 */
   118	export async function handleGetModels(): Promise<ModelEntry[]> {
   119	  return readModels();
   120	}
   121	
   122	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   123	// PUT /api/models
   124	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   125	
   126	/**
   127	 * Request body schema for PUT /api/models.
   128	 *
   129	 * Accepts an array of model entries. Entries missing `id` get a fresh UUIDv4
   130	 * assigned before the write is performed.
   131	 *
   132	 * We accept `id` as optional at the schema level so that the handler can
   133	 * auto-assign it. Downstream `writeModels()` requires full `ModelEntry`
   134	 * objects (id required), which is satisfied after UUID assignment.
   135	 */
   136	const SaveModelsBodySchema = z.array(
   137	  z.object({
   138	    id: z.string().uuid().optional(),
   139	    name: z.string().min(1),
   140	    slug: z.string().regex(/^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/),
   141	    cc_model: z.string().min(1).default('inherit'),
   142	  })
   143	);
   144	
   145	/**
   146	 * Bulk-saves the model registry.
   147	 *
   148	 * - Validates and auto-assigns UUIDv4 to any entry missing `id`.
   149	 * - Delegates validation (slug uniqueness, reserved slug, deletion guard) to
   150	 *   `writeModels()` from the model-registry module.
   151	 * - Returns 409 Conflict when a referenced model would be deleted.
   152	 *
   153	 * @param body - Raw parsed JSON request body.
   154	 */
   155	export async function handleSaveModels(body: unknown): Promise<{
   156	  models: ModelEntry[];
   157	} | {
   158	  conflict: true;
   159	  referencedModels: Array<{
   160	    model: ModelEntry;
   161	    usages: string[];
   162	  }>;
   163	}> {
   164	  const parsed = SaveModelsBodySchema.safeParse(body);
   165	  if (!parsed.success) {
   166	    validationError(
   167	      `Invalid model list: ${parsed.error.issues.map((i) => i.message).join('; ')}`
   168	    );
   169	  }
   170	
   171	  // Auto-assign UUIDv4 to entries missing an id
   172	  const enriched: ModelEntry[] = parsed.data.map((entry) => ({
   173	    id: entry.id ?? randomUUID(),
   174	    name: entry.name,
   175	    slug: entry.slug,
   176	    cc_model: entry.cc_model,
   177	  }));
   178	
   179	  const result = await writeModels(enriched);
   180	
   181	  if (!result.saved) {
   182	    // Deletion blocked — referenced models
   183	    conflictError(
   184	      'One or more models being removed are still referenced in persona model assignments. ' +
   185	        'Use the Replace Model feature to reassign them before removing.',
   186	      result.referencedModels
   187	    );
   188	  }
   189	
   190	  return { models: result.models };
   191	}
   192	
   193	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   194	// POST /api/models/load-defaults
   195	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   196	
   197	/**
   198	 * Merges `default.json` into `local.json`.
   199	 *
   200	 * Existing entries (by UUID) are never overwritten. Slug collisions between
   201	 * new default entries and existing local entries are reported as conflicts but
   202	 * do not block the merge.
   203	 *
   204	 * Returns the post-merge model list and the list of slug-collision conflicts.
   205	 */
   206	export async function handleLoadDefaults(): Promise<{
   207	  models: ModelEntry[];
   208	  conflicts: Array<{
   209	    defaultEntry: ModelEntry;
   210	    localEntry: ModelEntry;
   211	    reason: 'slug_collision';
   212	  }>;
   213	}> {
   214	  return loadDefaults();
   215	}
   216	
   217	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   218	// GET /api/model-assignments
   219	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   220	
   221	/**
   222	 * Staleness check.
   223	 *
   224	 * Returns `true` when `max(mtime(assignments.json), mtime(local.json))` is
   225	 * **greater than** `mtime(name-mapping.json)`, indicating that the user
   226	 * registry or assignments have changed since the last persona build.
   227	 *
   228	 * Staleness rules:
   229	 * - Returns `false` when neither assignments.json nor local.json exist (no
   230	 *   user modifications have been made yet — no build needed).
   231	 * - Returns `false` when only `default.json` exists (mtime reflects Git
   232	 *   checkout time, not user modification; excluded by design).
   233	 * - Returns `false` when name-mapping.json does not exist (no build output to
   234	 *   compare against).
   235	 *
   236	 * @internal
   237	 */
   238	async function computeStale(): Promise<boolean> {
   239	  const registryDir = modelRegistryDir();
   240	
   241	  const [assignmentsMtime, localMtime, nameMappingMtime] = await Promise.all([
   242	    getMtime(join(registryDir, 'assignments.json')),
   243	    getMtime(join(registryDir, 'local.json')),
   244	    getMtime(nameMappingPath()),
   245	  ]);
   246	
   247	  // No user files exist → never stale
   248	  if (assignmentsMtime === null && localMtime === null) {
   249	    return false;
   250	  }
